values.note: Nine sites in the catalog: eight take RVs/trailers (site 2 to 28 ft; 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8 to 26 ft; 5 only 21 ft) and site 9 (12 ft) takes only a car and tent. NPS says 8 sites in one place and 9 in another. Single vehicles over 36 ft and vehicle/trailer combinations over 42 ft are prohibited on the access road and in the campground; all vehicles must fit in the site's parking space. Up to 8 people and 4 tents per site. One site is wheelchair accessible.

values.note: Well water and vault toilets (seasonal); bear-proof food storage lockers. No dump stations anywhere in Pictured Rocks. Small boat ramp (electric motors only). No generators at Little Beaver; typically no cell reception.

values.note: All camping at Pictured Rocks is by reservation only; same-day reservations are accepted, and sites 4 and 5 open for booking only two weeks before arrival. Camping is limited to 14 days per calendar year within the Lakeshore. Check-out 11 a.m.

note: Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore drive-in campground at the end of Little Beaver Lake Road, 3 mi north of Alger County Road H-58 and 20 mi NE of Munising; all sites on or near Little Beaver Lake. The dirt access road is narrow, twisting and hilly. NO PETS in this campground (it borders the Beaver Basin Wilderness). 1-mile Little Beaver Nature Trail, and a 1.5-mile trail to Lake Superior and the North Country Trail. --Claude
